exposure: surgical intervention for gastrointestinal conditions during pregnancy
cohort: The study included pregnant women who underwent surgical intervention for gastrointestinal conditions at a tertiary care centre in South India.
finding: Two out of 19 pregnant women (10.5%) who underwent appendicectomy for acute appendicitis experienced preterm delivery postoperatively.
gest_age: Mean gestational age of 15 weeks +/- 2 weeks for patients undergoing appendicectomy.
